Native directory refresh temporarily removes the focused folder; now restores that exact still-expanded path once the row returns, unless later user input/focus or root lifetime supersedes it.

boundaries: Actual old r30 B11 red restores 2800 as0 after a CSS-delayed real remount. Two genuine native I red scenarios reproduce the lost pending scroll (2 failed/3 passed). First I invocation used a wrong broker path and failed setup; never counted as a business defect.

Old r30 B16 red loses actual folder focus after ArrowLeft and a genuine native directory refresh. Retained focus/key/mutation events show the removed row and keyUp/next ArrowRight reaching BODY. New package restores the exact folder before reopening, without an injected DOM focus.

Final native I nine scenarios retain actual root/list/read IO; only geometry, scroll clamping and ResizeObserver are layout substitutes. Additional root-read gate delays an actual completed native response. User external focus has priority.

Initial candidate resized the virtual window to zero for a hidden/jsdom viewport; now retains its last measured nonzero rendering height. Older scroll tests are corrected to supply 400px geometry and enough real tail files for genuine overflow. B12 now generates pointer/Meta key events, rather than a click-only substitute that omitted manual-input cancellation.

Actual/P drivers initially clicked loading or rearranging rows, and an early P wheel arrived before 300 children loaded. These failures remain archived; final drivers wait for actual rows/controls before input. P six light/dark theme behaviors use shared components and own syntheticFiles storage; no native IO or Codex full-pixel claim.

A B11 uses temporary viewport-only CSS to test hidden geometry; normal tree/root/menu controls and native data remain unchanged. Quiet all-renderer RAF counters do not claim tree-only attribution; I and source lifecycle checks establish no restoration RAF polling.

B16 uses sticky click to focus the matching underlying folder, then Left/Right to collapse/reopen it. This is not a claim that sticky click itself toggles, or that B17 unknown Enter/Space reference matrix is complete.

Normal packaged regressions cover tree4/reveal2/nested2/task3; directory4 retains DEV075 private native/IPC delivery gates and restoration of original authenticated handler. Receiver PTYs consume no commands, with all three states recording zero bytes/commands.

No production/prototype changes after build; only the external App driver waits/diagnostics changed. Final 938-source snapshot and81 packaged runtime assets match. No full-suite rerun implied by historical union1697.
No daily resources, AIS, old r4/r6 pending57 bytes, credentials, OS clipboard, model or external service accessed; no Git write/push/release.
